patch.sql:
select
    l_orderkey || '-' || l_linenumber as order_line_id,
    l_orderkey as order_key,
    l_linenumber as line_number,
    l_partkey as part_key,
    l_suppkey as supplier_key,
    l_quantity as quantity,
    l_extendedprice as extended_price,
    l_discount_rate as discount,
    l_tax as tax,
    l_returnflag as return_flag,
    l_shipdate as ship_date,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount_rate) as net_revenue
from {{ source('raw', 'lineitem') }}
patch.explanation: The upstream raw.lineitem table renamed the discount column from l_discount to l_discount_rate. The staging model still referenced the old name, causing a binder error. Updated the model to select l_discount_rate as discount and used the same column in the net_revenue calculation, preserving the original output column names and types.
